evals.prompt: Run evals for create-skill in a subagent
evals.expected_output: Executes isolated subagent eval, grades assertions, executes Step 3.5 teardown to purge any created test artifacts/symlinks, and saves regression report with zero residual test pollution.
assertions: Must spawn an isolated worker receiving strictly the eval prompt
Must grade behavioral assertions using LLM-as-judge against the returned trace
Must systematically tear down and purge any test artifacts, directories, or symlinks created during execution
Must leave production skill registries and workspaces completely free of test pollution
Must persist the regression report under <skill-dir>/evals/reports/
